summary.text: Josh Meggers (listed by Ballotpedia as Joshua Meggers) is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 54 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Meggers's career experience as a state trooper.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Meggers's career experience includes working as a state trooper, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2025-2026 session Meggers was assigned to the House Agriculture, Labor (as vice chair), Public Safety, House Transportation and House Ways and Means committees.
